# Architecture icon sources

AWS service SVGs are unchanged extracts from the official July 31, 2026 AWS architecture icon package, downloaded on October 10, 2026.

- Source: https://aws.amazon.com/architecture/icons/
- Package: https://d1.awsstatic.com/onedam/marketing-channels/website/public/shared/architecture-icon-release/Icon-package_07312026.5846e92413caa21490223536cc97f1269e44fa92.zip
- These service marks identify proposed service choices in architecture diagrams. They do not imply AWS endorsement or a deployed AWS environment.
- user.svg, browser.svg, review.svg, brief.svg, graph.svg, check.svg, package.svg and history.svg are original neutral interface symbols, not AWS service icons.
